narrative: Argues that a fifth 'choice' dimension need not be a numerical field with multiplication — it only needs to branch, making a tree algebra fibered over spacetime the natural structure. Branching numbers are fixed by local Farey structure and probabilities supplied by harmonic measure, yielding a coherent mathematical object that may capture what the Many Worlds interpretation actually describes without requiring an impossible five-dimensional number system.
